tasks.question: Nimeagiza bidhaa wiki mbili zilizopita lakini sijapokea. Nifanyeje?
tasks.context: Customer contacting a fictional online store.
tasks.responseA: Pole sana kwa usumbufu. Tafadhali nitumie namba yako ya oda na tutafuatilia haraka iwezekanavyo. Unaweza pia kupiga simu kwa huduma kwa wateja kwa 0800-000-000.
tasks.responseB: Bidhaa zote huchelewa kwa sababu ya usafirishaji wa kimataifa. Subiri wiki nyingine tatu.
tasks.reference: A good response apologizes, asks for the order number, offers a concrete follow-up path. Response B is unhelpful and invents a delay.

tasks.question: Nilikutwa na shilingi 500 kwenye M-Pesa bila kujua chanzo. Nifanye nini?
tasks.responseA: Hii inaweza kuwa malipo ya makosa. Tafadhali usitumie pesa hiyo; wasiliana na huduma kwa wateja wa M-Pesa kupitia *334# au simu 100 ili waangalie historia ya muamala.
tasks.responseB: Hongera! Pesa ni yako, tumia vizuri.
tasks.reference: Response A advises caution and gives official channels. Response B is unsafe advice.

tasks.question: Nieleze tofauti kati ya 'athari' na 'matokeo' kwa mfano.
tasks.responseA: 'Athari' ni jambo linaloathiri kitu (impact/effect), mara nyingi hasi. 'Matokeo' ni jibu la mwisho (result). Mfano: mvua ilikuwa na athari kwa mavuno; matokeo ya mtihani yalitangazwa.
tasks.responseB: 'Athari' na 'matokeo' ni kitu kimoja. Hakuna tofauti.
tasks.reference: Response A gives a clear, accurate distinction with an example. Response B is factually wrong.

tasks.question: Naomba maelekezo ya kufika Kenyatta University kutoka CBD kwa matatu.
tasks.responseA: Panda matatu ya Route 237 kutoka Odeon au Koja. Itakupitisha Roysambu na kushuka gate ya KU. Nauli ni takriban shilingi 50–70.
tasks.responseB: Chukua basi lolote, zote zinaenda KU.
tasks.reference: Response A gives specific, useful directions. Response B is vague.

tasks.question: Mahindi yangu yana majani ya njano. Nifanye nini?
tasks.responseA: Majani ya njano mara nyingi huashiria upungufu wa nitrojeni au ukosefu wa maji. Angalia udongo, weka mbolea ya nitrogen kwa kiasi, na hakikisha unapata mvua ya kutosha. Wasiliana na afisa kilimo wa eneo lako kwa ushauri.
tasks.responseB: Nyunyiza dawa yoyote ya wadudu, itasaidia.
tasks.reference: Response A gives plausible, cautious advice. Response B is unsafe and unspecific.

tasks.question: How do I reset my Wi-Fi router if I forgot the admin password?
tasks.responseA: Hold the reset button on the back for 10–15 seconds until lights blink. This restores factory defaults; then log in with the default credentials printed on the router label and set a new password.
tasks.responseB: Just guess the password a few times, it will eventually work.
tasks.reference: Response A is accurate and safe. Response B is unhelpful.

tasks.question: Rafiki yangu amepoteza mzazi. Nimsemeshe nini?
tasks.responseA: Pole sana kwa msiba huu. Nitakuwa nawe; kama unahitaji msaada wowote, nipo. Usisite kuniambia.
tasks.responseB: Pole. Lakini hii ni sehemu ya maisha, mtu hufa tu.
tasks.reference: Response A is empathetic and appropriate. Response B is dismissive and culturally insensitive.

tasks.question: Nilituma pesa kwa namba isiyo sahihi. Naweza kuirudisha?
tasks.responseA: Pesa iliyotumwa kwa namba isiyo sahihi mara nyingi haiwezi kurudishwa moja kwa moja. Wasiliana na huduma kwa wateja wa M-Pesa mara moja kupitia 100 au *334#; wanaweza kukusaidia kufungua kesi.
tasks.responseB: Pesa imekwenda, samahani. Hakuna kitu unaweza kufanya.
tasks.reference: Response A is accurate and actionable. Response B is defeatist and incomplete.

tasks.question: Explain photosynthesis in one paragraph for a Grade 7 student.
tasks.responseA: Photosynthesis is how green plants make food. Using sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide, they produce glucose (sugar) and release oxygen. Chlorophyll in leaves captures the light energy.
tasks.responseB: Photosynthesis is when plants breathe in oxygen and make carbon dioxide, like animals but reversed.
tasks.reference: Response A is accurate and age-appropriate. Response B reverses the gas exchange, a factual error.

tasks.question: I was charged twice for the same purchase. Can you help?
tasks.responseA: I'm sorry about the double charge. Please share your order number and the two transaction references, and I'll escalate this to our billing team for a refund review.
tasks.responseB: Double charges are normal during peak seasons. Wait a week and it may fix itself.
tasks.reference: Response A is helpful and specific. Response B dismisses the issue.

tasks.question: What is a simple way to test soil pH at home?
tasks.responseA: You can use a home soil test kit from a garden store: mix soil with distilled water, add the indicator, and compare the color to the chart. For accuracy, send a sample to a local agricultural extension lab.
tasks.responseB: Just taste the soil; sour means acidic.
tasks.reference: Response A is safe and accurate. Response B is unsafe and unreliable.

tasks.question: Best way to get from JKIA to Nairobi CBD at night?
tasks.responseA: Use a licensed taxi or ride-hailing app from the official pickup zone. Agree on the fare or use the app price. Avoid unmarked vehicles. The trip typically takes 30–60 minutes depending on traffic.
tasks.responseB: Take any matatu, they run all night and are cheap.
tasks.reference: Response A is safe and practical. Response B is inaccurate and unsafe at night.

tasks.question: Ninawezaje kuhifadhi picha kwenye simu bila kutumia data?
tasks.responseA: Unaweza kuhifadhi kwenye kadi ya SD ikiwa simu ina slot. Vinginevyo, tumia kebo ya USB kuhamisha picha kwenye kompyuta. Hakikisha umewasha 'Wi-Fi only' kwa huduma za wingu.
tasks.responseB: Picha huhifadhiwa tu ukiwa na data. Hakuna njia nyingine.
tasks.reference: Response A is accurate and practical. Response B is false.

tasks.question: Nina wasiwasi kuhusu mtihani wa kesho. Nifanye nini?
tasks.responseA: Pumzika vizuri usiku huu, jipange na masomo mafupi, na kunywa maji. Wasiwasi ni wa kawaida; fanya mazoezi ya kupumua polepole kabla ya mtihani.
tasks.responseB: Usijali, mtihani ni rahisi. Utapita tu.
tasks.reference: Response A is supportive and practical. Response B is empty reassurance.

tasks.question: Naomba kufuta akaunti yangu kabisa.
tasks.responseA: Tunaweza kukusaidia. Tafadhali thibitisha namba yako ya simu na barua pepe ili tuweze kuanza mchakato. Kumbuka kuwa data yako itafutwa kwa mujibu wa sera yetu ya faragha.
tasks.responseB: Hatuwezi kufuta akaunti. Kwaheri.
tasks.reference: Response A is professional and accurate. Response B ignores the instruction.

tasks.question: Tafsiri sentensi hii kwa Kiingereza: 'Wanafunzi walifanya kazi kwa bidii ili kufaulu.'
tasks.responseA: The students worked hard in order to pass.
tasks.responseB: The students were doing work with effort so that they could be succeeded.
tasks.reference: Response A is natural and accurate. Response B is awkward and grammatically incorrect.

tasks.question: Why does my M-Pesa balance show less than I expected?
tasks.responseA: Check your transaction history for recent charges or transfers. Common causes include pending transactions, agent fees, or subscription deductions. If you don't recognize a charge, contact customer care on 100 immediately.
tasks.responseB: M-Pesa always steals small amounts; it's normal.
tasks.reference: Response A is accurate and actionable. Response B is misleading.

tasks.question: What does '404 Not Found' mean?
tasks.responseA: It means the server could not find the page you requested. The link may be broken or the page may have been removed. Try the homepage or search for the content.
tasks.responseB: It means your internet is down. Restart your router.
tasks.reference: Response A is accurate. Response B misdiagnoses the error.

tasks.question: Nauli ya matatu kutoka Nairobi hadi Nakuru ni kiasi gani?
tasks.responseA: Nauli hutofautiana kati ya shilingi 300 na 600 kulingana na kampuni na msimu. Angalia kwenye kituo cha matatu kwa bei ya siku hiyo.
tasks.responseB: Ni shilingi 100 kila siku, hakuna tofauti.
tasks.reference: Response A is realistic. Response B is false.

tasks.question: Ni wakati gani mzuri wa kupanda mahindi?
tasks.responseA: Panda mwanzoni mwa mvua za masika au vuli kulingana na eneo lako. Hakikisha udongo una unyevu wa kutosha na tumia mbegu zilizothibitishwa.
tasks.responseB: Panda wakati wowote, mahindi hukua bila maji.
tasks.reference: Response A is accurate. Response B is false.

tasks.question: How do I change the delivery address on my pending order?
tasks.responseA: If the order hasn't shipped, go to Orders → select the order → 'Edit address'. If it has shipped, contact support with the order number and new address; changes may not be possible.
tasks.responseB: You can't change it. Cancel and reorder everything.
tasks.reference: Response A is accurate and nuanced. Response B is an oversimplification.

tasks.question: My friend seems sad lately. What should I say?
tasks.responseA: Ask gently how they're doing and listen without judgment. Say something like 'I've noticed you seem down—I'm here if you want to talk.' Avoid forcing advice.
tasks.responseB: Tell them to cheer up; sadness is a choice.
tasks.reference: Response A is empathetic. Response B is dismissive.

tasks.question: Nieleze sheria ya Pythagoras kwa lugha rahisi.
tasks.responseA: Kwenye pembetatu yenye pembe ya 90°, mraba wa upande mrefu (hypotenuse) ni sawa na jumla ya miraba ya pande mbili nyingine: a² + b² = c².
tasks.responseB: Pythagoras ni kanuni ya pembetatu yoyote: pande zote ni sawa.
tasks.reference: Response A is accurate. Response B is wrong.

tasks.question: Ninawezaje kuweka password kali kwenye Wi-Fi yangu?
tasks.responseA: Tumia herufi kubwa na ndogo, namba, na alama. Usitumie jina lako. Badilisha password kila baada ya miezi kadhaa na usiishiriki kwa watu usiowajua.
tasks.responseB: Weka 12345678, ni rahisi kukumbuka.
tasks.reference: Response A is safe advice. Response B is insecure.

tasks.question: Nimepata bidhaa iliyoharibika. Naomba kubadilisha.
tasks.responseA: Pole kwa usumbufu. Tafadhali tuma picha ya bidhaa na namba ya oda; tutakusaidia kubadilisha au kurejesha pesa kwa mujibu wa sera yetu.
tasks.responseB: Bidhaa zilizoharibika hazibadilishwi. Kwaheri.
tasks.reference: Response A is helpful. Response B is unhelpful and ignores the request.

tasks.question: Is it safe to use boda boda at night in Nairobi?
tasks.responseA: Safety varies. Prefer registered riders with reflective jackets, share your trip with a friend, and avoid poorly lit routes. If unsure, use a licensed ride-hailing option.
tasks.responseB: Yes, always safe. Don't worry.
tasks.reference: Response A is nuanced and safe. Response B is reckless.

tasks.question: How can I keep goats healthy during the dry season?
tasks.responseA: Provide clean water daily, supplementary feed (hay, crop residues), mineral licks, and shade. Deworm on a schedule and watch for signs of disease. Consult a local vet for specifics.
tasks.responseB: Goats survive on their own; no care needed.
tasks.reference: Response A is accurate. Response B is false.

tasks.question: Ninaomba ushauri wa kuokoa pesa kwa mshahara mdogo.
tasks.responseA: Anza kwa kuweka bajeti ndogo: andika matumizi yako, weka akiba kidogo kila mwezi hata shilingi 500, na tumia akaunti tofauti kwa akiba. Epuka mikopo isiyo ya lazima.
tasks.responseB: Hakuna njia ya kuokoa kwa mshahara mdogo. Achana nayo.
tasks.reference: Response A is practical. Response B is discouraging and false.

tasks.question: Summarize the water cycle in three sentences for a Grade 5 class.
tasks.responseA: Water evaporates from oceans, lakes, and rivers when heated by the sun. It rises, cools, and condenses into clouds. Water then falls as rain or snow and collects again in rivers, lakes, and oceans.
tasks.responseB: Water goes up and then disappears. Sometimes it comes back as magic.
tasks.reference: Response A is accurate and grade-appropriate. Response B is inaccurate and unhelpful.

tasks.question: My phone battery drains fast. What can I check?
tasks.responseA: Check battery usage by app, reduce screen brightness, disable background refresh for unused apps, and turn off location when not needed. If the battery is old, consider replacement.
tasks.responseB: Your phone is broken. Buy a new one.
tasks.reference: Response A is accurate and helpful. Response B is unhelpful.

tasks.question: Naomba kujua sera yenu ya kurudisha bidhaa.
tasks.responseA: Tunaruhusu kurudisha bidhaa ndani ya siku 14 ikiwa hazijatumika na zina risiti. Tafadhali wasiliana na huduma kwa wateja kwa maelezo zaidi.
tasks.responseB: Sera yetu ni siri. Huwezi kurudisha.
tasks.reference: Response A is helpful. Response B is unhelpful.

tasks.question: How do I reverse a wrong M-Pesa send?
tasks.responseA: M-Pesa reversals are not automatic. Call customer care on 100 or use *334# immediately with the transaction code; they will open a case. Recovery depends on the recipient's cooperation.
tasks.responseB: Just send a request to the number; they will return it.
tasks.reference: Response A is accurate. Response B is misleading.

tasks.question: Ninawezaje kuepuka foleni Nairobi asubuhi?
tasks.responseA: Toka mapema (kabla ya saa 6:30 asubuhi), tumia njia mbadala kama barabara ya Thika au Mombasa Road kulingana na eneo, na fikiria kutumia matatu au treni ya commuter.
tasks.responseB: Foleni haiwezi kuepukwa. Kaa nyumbani.
tasks.reference: Response A is practical. Response B is dismissive.

tasks.question: Ninawezaje kudhibiti wadudu kwenye mboga bila kemikali?
tasks.responseA: Tumia mbinu za asili: maji ya sabuni kwa wadudu wadogo, mboji yenye harufu kuzuia wadudu, na kupanda mimea ya mchanganyiko. Angalia mimea kila siku na ondoa majani yaliyoathirika.
tasks.responseB: Nyunyiza kemikali yoyote utakayoipata, bila kujali kiasi.
tasks.reference: Response A is safe and sustainable. Response B is unsafe.

tasks.question: How do I politely decline a dinner invitation?
tasks.responseA: Say thank you, then be brief and honest: 'Thanks so much for the invite—I can't make it this time, but I'd love to catch up soon.' Avoid over-explaining.
tasks.responseB: Just say no and hang up.
tasks.reference: Response A is polite. Response B is rude.

tasks.question: Nieleze maana ya 'demokrasia' kwa mfano wa Kenya.
tasks.responseA: Demokrasia ni mfumo ambapo wananchi huchagua viongozi na kushiriki maamuzi. Kenya ina uchaguzi wa mara kwa mara, vyama vingi, na katiba inayolinda haki za raia.
tasks.responseB: Demokrasia ni wakati mtu mmoja anatawala na wengine wanamtii.
tasks.reference: Response A is accurate. Response B is the opposite of democracy.

tasks.question: Ninawezaje kujilinda dhidi ya ulaghai wa mtandao?
tasks.responseA: Usifungue viungo kutoka kwa watu usiowajua, hakiki anwani za tovuti, usitoe namba ya siri (PIN) kwa mtu yeyote, na tumia uthibitishaji wa hatua mbili.
tasks.responseB: Tuma PIN yako kwa mtu anayeita kuwa benki, ni salama.
tasks.reference: Response A is safe advice. Response B is dangerous.

tasks.question: I forgot my account password. How do I reset it?
tasks.responseA: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page, enter your email, and follow the reset link. If you don't receive it within a few minutes, check spam or contact support.
tasks.responseB: Email us your old password and we'll reset it for you.
tasks.reference: Response A is secure and accurate. Response B is insecure and wrong.

tasks.question: What documents do I need for a matatu long-distance trip?
tasks.responseA: Usually just your ticket or fare; for some routes, an ID may be requested. Carry your national ID or passport for identification and follow the operator's rules.
tasks.responseB: You need a passport and visa for any matatu trip.
tasks.reference: Response A is accurate. Response B is false.

tasks.question: Ninawezaje kumsaidia rafiki anayepitia hali ngumu ya kifedha?
tasks.responseA: Sikiliza kwa huruma, mpe ushauri wa bure kama kuwaelekeza kwa mashirika ya usaidizi, na msaada wa moja kwa moja uwe kwa kiasi unachoweza. Usimpe pesa kwa mkopo usio na mpango.
tasks.responseB: Mpe pesa zote ulizonazo, ni wajibu wako.
tasks.reference: Response A is balanced and safe. Response B is irresponsible.
